media.alt_text: Rows of white maneki-neko beckoning cat statues at Gotokuji Temple in Tokyo

caption.body: Gōtokuji Temple in Tokyo — the birthplace of the maneki-neko. Hundreds of white beckoning cat statues tucked into every corner. It's off the main tourist path and worth the detour.
caption.full_text:
